properties.name: Allbirds
properties.description: Allbirds sells comfortable, sustainably made shoes and apparel using natural materials like Merino wool, tree fiber, and sugarcane.
properties.gtm_first_line: Allbirds works with natural and recycled materials like responsibly-sourced Merino wool, tree fiber, and sugarcane, and describes this as working with Mother Nature.
properties.gtm_evidence: We work with—not against—Mother Nature, favoring both recycled and natural materials like responsibly-sourced Merino wool, tree fiber, and sugarcane.

properties.name: Brooklinen
properties.description: Brooklinen is a Brooklyn-founded DTC seller of premium sheets, bedding, pillows, and towels, with sitewide sales and free shipping over $100.
properties.gtm_first_line: Brooklinen started in Brooklyn in 2014, selling premium, hotel-quality sheets and towels at accessible prices straight to customers.
properties.gtm_evidence: Founded in Brooklyn in 2014, we disrupted the bedding industry with premium, hotel-quality sheets and towels at accessible prices, direct to your door.

properties.name: Buffy
properties.description: A DTC bedding brand selling eucalyptus, linen, and cotton sheets, duvet covers, pillows, comforters, and blankets.
properties.gtm_first_line: Buffy offers 100% long-staple Supima Cotton bedding that is exclusively grown in America.
properties.gtm_evidence: Experience remarkable softness and durability with 100% long-staple Supima Cotton, exclusively grown in America.

properties.name: Chubbies
properties.description: Chubbies sells men's shorts, swim trunks, and casual apparel built for the weekend, backed by a mental-health-focused foundation.
properties.gtm_first_line: Chubbies exists to bring its community back to the moment and deliver that Friday at 5pm feeling every day of the week.
properties.gtm_evidence: we exist to bring our community back to the moment and deliver that Friday at 5pm feeling every day of the week.

properties.name: Glossier
properties.description: Glossier is a direct-to-consumer beauty brand selling makeup, skincare, fragrance, and body care with free-shipping and gift promotions.
properties.gtm_first_line: Glossier prioritizes skincare because it believes healthy skin is the best foundation for makeup.
properties.gtm_evidence: We prioritize skincare because we believe that healthy skin is the best foundation.

properties.name: Grovemade
properties.description: Grovemade sells walnut, maple, and oak desk furniture and accessories for home workspaces, with its headquarters in Portland, Oregon.
properties.gtm_first_line: Grovemade believes the physical environment matters in the pursuit of meaningful work and should feel calm, mindful and peaceful.
properties.gtm_evidence: We believe that the physical environment matters in the pursuit of meaningful work. It should be calm, mindful and peaceful

properties.name: Harrys
properties.description: Harry's sells shaving, skincare, body, hair, and cologne products, positioned as high-performance grooming at a fair price.
properties.gtm_first_line: Harry's says its founders Jeff and Andy believed men deserved a great shave without overpaying.
properties.gtm_evidence: Jeff and Andy thought men deserved a great shave without overpaying.

properties.name: Jennikayne
properties.description: Jenni Kayne is a California-inspired lifestyle brand selling apparel, shoes, accessories, furniture, decor, and Oak Essentials skincare.
properties.gtm_first_line: Jenni Kayne is a lifestyle brand born from a California sensibility, known for enduring classics that transcend trends.
properties.gtm_evidence: Jenni Kayne is a lifestyle brand born from a California sensibility, known for our enduring classics that transcend trends and become heirlooms throughout time.

properties.name: Mvmt
properties.description: MVMT is a direct-to-consumer brand selling watches, sunglasses, and jewelry, with a current sitewide buy-one-get-one 50% off promotion.

properties.gtm_evidence: Dreamed in California Bringing the unexpected to timekeeping since 2013

properties.name: Nativecos
properties.description: Native sells clean, aluminum-free deodorants and body, hair, and skin care products across many scent families, with bundles and seasonal limited editions.
properties.gtm_first_line: Native makes clean products with no aluminum, dyes, sulfates, silicones, phthalates or petrolatum, aimed at hair and body care people can feel confident about.
properties.gtm_evidence: We make clean products with no aluminum, dyes, sulfates, silicones, phthalates, petrolatum, and more. It’s hair and body care you can feel confident about.

properties.name: Outdoorvoices
properties.description: Outdoor Voices sells technical recreation activewear for men and women, emphasizing movement, outdoor activities, and free shipping over $100.
properties.gtm_first_line: Outdoor Voices makes technical apparel for recreation, designed as the uniform for doing things.
properties.gtm_evidence: At Outdoor Voices, we make Technical Apparel for Recreation, designing the uniform for Doing Things with materials made for movement.

properties.name: Parachutehome
properties.description: Parachute Home sells bedding, bath linens, and decor, designed in Los Angeles and made by partner craftspeople, with a free-shipping and 60-day returns policy.
properties.gtm_first_line: Parachute Home says its cult-favorite linens are designed in Los Angeles and made with love by craftspeople around the world.
properties.gtm_evidence: Our cult-favorite linens are designed in Los Angeles and made with love by craftspeople around the world.

properties.name: Peakdesign
properties.description: Peak Design sells bags, camera gear, phone cases, tripods, and wallets, with a Fair Trade focus and no outside investors.
properties.gtm_first_line: Peak Design says all of its bags are Fair Trade certified.
properties.gtm_evidence: All of our bags are Fair Trade certified.

properties.name: Ridge
properties.description: Ridge sells wallets, rings, tech, luggage and drinkware, backed by lifetime warranty and a 99-day risk-free trial.
properties.gtm_first_line: Ridge says its minimalist first approach to design turned the old stuff-everything-in wallet on its head, so people can carry less.
properties.gtm_evidence: We turned that on its head with our minimalist first approach to design. So you can carry less and live more.

properties.name: Ritual
properties.description: Ritual is a DTC women's health supplement brand emphasizing traceable sourcing, clinical studies, and science-backed formulas for pregnancy through perimenopause.
properties.gtm_first_line: Ritual says it has spent a decade building traceable supply chains and clinical proof for its supplements.
properties.gtm_evidence: That’s why Ritual has spent a decade building traceable supply chains and clinical proof.

properties.name: Taylorstitch
properties.description: Taylor Stitch sells men's classic clothing, emphasizing durable shirting, responsible fabrics, and long-lasting construction.
properties.gtm_first_line: Taylor Stitch says it has always been a shirting company at its core and always will be.
properties.gtm_evidence: We’ve always considered ourselves a shirting company at our very core. Always have. Always will.

properties.gtm_evidence: Vuori makes premium performance apparel inspired by the active Coastal California lifestyle; an integration of fitness, surf, sport, and art.
